extracted.name: English garden cocktail
extracted.description: Celebrate summer with an English garden cocktail. It's a refreshing mix of gin, elderflower cordial and apple juice, plus mint, lemon and cucumber flavours
ingredient_lines: 2 tsp elderflower cordial (use more or less, depending on how sweet you like it)
cloudy apple juice for topping up
1 long strip of cucumber peeled using a vegetable peeler
instruction_lines: Mix the mint leaves, gin, elderflower cordial and lemon juice together in the bottom of a tall glass using a long-handled spoon.
Add a large handful of ice, then top up with the apple juice. Stir well, then drop in the strip of cucumber before serving.
